title: The Long Way Through the Trees
alt: Panoramic pencil landscape: A wooded valley gathers a leaf-eared cat, orb juggler, staff-carrying bird and horned goat around a winding path and stream, with a curled fish below and a feathered bird overhead.
description: A wooded valley gathers a leaf-eared cat, orb juggler, staff-carrying bird and horned goat around a winding path and stream, with a curled fish below and a feathered bird overhead.

title: The Long River Gathering
alt: A wide pencil river valley holds a fish, turtle, snail, frog, two birds, an egg hatchling and a sail-backed creature among four distinctive tree designs.
description: Twelve curated doodles gather along a winding river, with small bankside groups, a leafy island and distant tree-lined bends.

title: The Sculpture Park Beyond the Hill
alt: A broad pencil landscape of a hillside sculpture park, with eccentric eye monuments, five doodle visitors, three kinds of trees and a little candle platform linked by a winding path.
description: A winding park path brings twelve notebook designs together across terraces, trees and strange monuments.
